questions.q: How much time should thinking and strategizing take?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says planning deserves roughly 15 to 20 percent of your time.

questions.q: What does the summary say envy can reveal?
a: What you lack and want to achieve
How much you have already grown
questions.why: Lesson 2 says envy points to something missing from your life that you want.

questions.q: How can thinking about death help you think more effectively?
a: It reminds you what is important
It pushes you to work constantly
questions.why: Lesson 2 says mortality can clarify priorities and help you release trivial concerns.

questions.q: Why should you question your own conclusions?
a: Your thinking is faulty and can be wrong
It prevents you from ever deciding
questions.why: Lesson 3 says accepting that your thinking is imperfect helps you weigh other perspectives.

questions.q: What should you do after accepting a point of view?
a: Be firm but keep some skepticism
questions.why: Lesson 3 advises being firm and concise while remembering you could still be partly wrong.
